overview_description.description: Mazeed offers automated accounting software for business owners, accountants, and firms. The platform allows users to scan and upload receipts, which are then processed for accounting and tax purposes. It provides bookkeeping, invoicing, tax filing, and financial reporting services. Certified accountants and tax agents are available to support users with compliance and regulatory needs. The company also offers a mobile app for monitoring finances and accessing services anywhere.

about_short_description.short_description: Mazeed offers automated accounting software for business owners, accountants, and firms.

product.name: Automated Accounting Software
product.description: Software that automates the entire accounting cycle from recording daily transactions to generating financial reports in compliance with local standards.

product.name: Taxation Services
product.description: Certified tax agents provide tax registration, filing, and compliance services to ensure adherence to local tax laws and avoid penalties.

product.name: CFO Advisory Services
product.description: Financial experts provide tailored planning, budgeting, and strategic financial advice to help businesses achieve their goals.

product.name: Mobile Accounting Application
product.description: A mobile app that allows users to capture invoices, automate financial processes, generate reports, and manage finances on the go.

product.name: Invoicing Software
product.description: Software to create, customize, send, and track invoices, including payment reminders and compliance with local VAT regulations.
